Module 14 of 15

The 21 product journeys: deep dives

Every product LoanOS ships, one page each: the business, the risk, the contract and its current maturity.

LoanOS defines exactly 21 canonical lending journeys as checksummed product contracts. This module gives a BA one deep-dive per journey: who borrows and why, where the risk and regulation concentrate, and — derived live from the contract — the required facts, evidence, facility, security and servicing capabilities, with the honest platform-support level from the journey support matrix.

21 lessons210 min guided timeComplete in sequence

Lesson 14.1 · 10 min

Personal loan

  • Explain the unsecured personal term loan end to end
  • Name the affordability tests and rails that carry it

Lesson 14.2 · 10 min

MSME term loan

  • Underwrite a business rather than a salary
  • Use GST, Udyam and cash-flow evidence correctly

Lesson 14.3 · 10 min

Professional practice loan

  • Distinguish practice lending from generic business lending
  • Anchor eligibility on professional registration

Lesson 14.4 · 10 min

Secured business loan

  • Add collateral machinery to business underwriting
  • Walk title, valuation, LTV and perfection

Lesson 14.5 · 10 min

Loan against property

  • Contrast LAP with home loans
  • Treat end-use and encumbrance as first-class risks

Lesson 14.6 · 10 min

Home loan

  • Sequence the property purchase into the credit journey
  • Handle construction-linked disbursement and RERA

Lesson 14.7 · 10 min

Equipment & machinery finance

  • Run supplier-and-asset verification alongside credit
  • Track the asset from invoice to installation

Lesson 14.8 · 10 min

Green equipment finance

  • Layer green-taxonomy evidence onto asset finance

Lesson 14.9 · 10 min

Personal vehicle loan

  • Run the dealer-anchored purchase flow

Lesson 14.10 · 10 min

Commercial vehicle finance

Lesson 14.11 · 10 min

Lesson 14.16 · 10 min

Lesson 14.17 · 10 min

Lesson 14.18 · 10 min
